scope: S2 solo DEV only; not paired transport or formal research

camera_mount_and_intrinsics: unchanged v3; no real measured mount evidence
fixed_sag_scope: previously frozen sensitivity assumption, not a measured REAL_DELIVERY calibration; no height adjustment or refit

optimistic_visibility: static walls only; also report self-command proxy occlusion; unknown new-pose cargo never placed using old held GT

simulation: no new simulation unless all admission requirements pass
